notes: Cleaner, sturdier app. If Cove's helper stops, the window now shows Cove's own reconnect screen with a Start Cove button and comes back by itself, instead of Edge's error page. Opening Cove while it is already open brings the window forward. Old shortcuts that flashed a console window are fixed automatically. Artwork lookups back off when a site is busy. Exported setups and share packs no longer include your wallpaper paths, and other websites can no longer embed Cove.
